description: Defines the HttpAuthHandler interface for handling various HTTP authentication schemes (basic, digest, NTLM, Negotiate) including initialization from challenges, token generation, and challenge handling.

classes.name: HttpAuthHandler
classes.description: Interface for HTTP authentication scheme handlers, managing challenge initialization, token generation, and challenge responses.

methods.name: InitFromChallenge
methods.description: Initializes the handler with a server challenge, storing relevant info for authentication.

methods.name: HandleAnotherChallenge
methods.description: Handles server/proxy challenges after an initial attempt, determining if further authentication is needed.

methods.name: GenerateAuthToken
methods.description: Generates an authentication token, possibly asynchronously, for HTTP requests.

methods.name: NeedsIdentity
methods.description: Indicates if the handler requires an identity to generate tokens.

methods.name: AllowsDefaultCredentials
methods.description: Checks if default credentials can be used for the challenge.

methods.name: AllowsExplicitCredentials
methods.description: Indicates if explicit user credentials can be used.
